self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 Rondo of Slumber: performing healing grants Vatsamonga's Vatic Vintage (10s, max 3 stacks, works off-field): +4% Max HP per stack on the wielder, and while a nearby party member has triggered Frozen or Stellar Swirl in the last 5s the boost is 75% larger (+7% per stack). The +4% Healing Bonus is not modelled. The same stacks also raise the ACTIVE character's ATK off the wielder's HP -- that half is the others-scope vaticVintageActiveAtk* inputs (a wielder that is itself the scored on-field character would need an ATK%-from-HP-excess conversion that does not exist; her own ATK barely matters on an HP scaler). R2-R5 in refinementStates.

others_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 Rondo of Slumber, others scope, 3 stacks assumed (a healer that heals every few seconds keeps them up): the currently active party member's ATK is increased by 0.4% per stack for every 1,000 Max HP the WIELDER has over 40,000, capped at 8% per stack -- i.e. 1.2% per 1,000 HP over 40,000, capped at +24% at 60,000 HP. Type the wielder's Max HP; blank assumes 50,000 (= +12% ATK). R1 rate only: at R5 the rate and cap double, which this input cannot express -- scale by hand or pick R1. Use the *ReactionBoosted twin instead when Frozen / Stellar Swirl keeps the +75% up.

R1 Rondo of Slumber, others scope, 3 stacks with the Frozen / Stellar Swirl +75% boost up for the whole rotation: the active character's ATK is increased by 2.1% per 1,000 Max HP the WIELDER has over 40,000, capped at +42%. Type the wielder's Max HP; blank assumes 50,000 (= +21% ATK). R1 rate only. Exclusive with vaticVintageActiveAtk.

source.note: 7.1 weapon, added 2026-09-22 (release day) from nanoka 7.1 data; neither Amber nor GO carry it yet. Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add (the derivation validated against the existing seed files for the 7.0 batch). Buffs baked at R1 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1, higher tiers in refinementStates). Vodyanitsa's signature. The ATK cap reads as per stack (0.4%/1,000 -> 8% at 60,000 HP), so 3 stacks cap at 24%; if it turns out to be a total cap, halve the caps here.

en.flavor: An exquisite lamp crafted out of blue chalcedony which looks like a treasure right out of a fairy tale. It is said that a song of praise, forgotten by all, slumbers sealed inside this lamp.

refinements.1:
Increases Healing Bonus by <r>4%</r>.
When performing healing, the equipping character gains the "Vatsamonga's Vatic Vintage" effect, which increases Max HP by <r>4%</r> as well as increases the currently active party member's ATK by <r>0.4%</r> for every 1,000 Max HP the equipping character has over 40,000. A maximum of <r>8%</r> ATK can be gained in this way. This effect lasts 10s, max 3 stacks.
When a nearby party member triggers a Frozen or Stellar Swirl reaction, the aforementioned Max HP and ATK boosts will be further increased by 75% for the next 5s.
The aforementioned effects can still trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field.

fr.flavor: Une lampe exquise, façonnée en calcédoine bleue, qui semble tout droit sortie d'un conte de fées. On raconte qu'un chant de louange oublié de tous est scellé à l'intérieur de cette lampe.

refinements.1:
Le bonus de soins augmente de <r>4 %</r>.
En effectuant des soins, le personnage équipé de l'arme obtient l'effet Vintage vatique de Vatsamonga : les PV max augmentent de <r>4 %</r> et chaque tranche de 1 000 PV max du personnage équipé de l'arme au-dessus de 40 000 augmente l'ATQ de votre personnage déployé de l'équipe de <r>0,4 %</r>, l'ATQ pouvant être augmentée d'un maximum de <r>8 %</r> de cette manière. Cet effet dure 10 s et peut être cumulé 3 fois maximum.
Lorsqu'un personnage de l'équipe à proximité déclenche une réaction de Gel ou d'Astrodispersion, les bonus de PV max et d'ATQ de cet effet augmentent de 75 % supplémentaires pendant 5 s.
Les effets susmentionnés peuvent être déclenchés même si le personnage équipé de l'arme fait partie de l'équipe mais n'est pas déployé.

pt.flavor: Uma lâmpada refinada feita de calcedônia azul que parece um tesouro de um conto de fadas. Dizem que há um louvor inesquecível dentro dessa lâmpada.

refinements.1:
Aumenta o Bônus de Cura em <r>4%</r>.
Ao curar, o portador obtém o efeito Relíquia Profética de Vatsamonga: aumenta a Vida Máxima em <r>4%</r>, e para cada 1.000 de Vida Máxima acima de 40.000 da Vida Máxima do portador, aumenta o ATQ do personagem ativo em <r>0.4%</r>. É possível elevar até <r>8%</r> dessa forma por 10s. Esse efeito acumula até 3 vezes.
Nos 5s após um personagem próximo da equipe causar Congelamento ou Redemoinho Estelar, esse efeito de aumento de Vida Máxima e ATQ pode aumentar em mais 75%.
Esse efeito pode ser desencadeado mesmo quando o portador não for o personagem ativo.

zh.flavor: 蓝玉髓所铸的精致灯盏，仿若自童话中诞生的宝物，据闻尘封着一曲为所有人忘却的颂歌。

refinements.1:
治疗加成提升<r>4%</r>；
进行治疗时，装备者获得「告真的蜜酿」效果：生命值上限提升<r>4%</r>，且基于装备者生命值上限超过40000的部分，每1000点生命值上限都会使队伍中自己的当前场上角色的攻击力提升<r>0.4%</r>，通过这种方式至多提升<r>8%</r>。该效果持续10秒，至多叠加3层。
队伍中附近的角色触发冻结反应或星扩散反应后的5秒内，上述效果中生命值上限与攻击力提升的效果额外提高75%。
装备者处于队伍后台时，依然能触发上述效果。
